notes: Discovery notes (2025-10-05): catalog ~4.2M SKUs including color/size variants; expect seasonal peak 6-8x traffic (Nov-Dec).
Primary problem: relevance on fuzzy/intent queries; want embeddings + lightweight reranker to lift conversion on 'near miss' search terms.
Throughput & latency targets: p95 end-to-end (vector lookup + model rerank) under 120ms prefer; can accept ~200ms for complex rerank on long queries.
Cost sensitivity: target <$0.002 per query at peak; current vendor ~ $0.01/query — major driver for re-eval.
Indexing cadence: daily delta ingestion, weekly full rebuild; expect index to grow to ~25M vectors post-variants expansion.
Retention/ops: keep vectors 90 days, audit trail for updates, must support partial backfills without full stop-the-world rebuild.
POC status: initial hosted_api sandbox yielded +6% CTR on fuzzy queries in small A/B (internal). Team wants expanded 2M q/day sim.
Engineering ask: SDKs for batch index writes + sample code for prefix/KV caching; interest in Redwood Optimize's batching/quantization recommendations.
Security: SAML SSO, audit logs, KMS integration required; data residency US + EU for different brands; exploring Private deployment for EU catalog.
Routing needs: automatic fallback to cheaper smaller model for low-value queries; prefer policy-based routing by latency and cost tiers.
Quote from Head of Search: 'If we can shave cost and maintain p95, we can roll this out sitewide for the holiday season.'
